## NexusDetalleServicio (Dynatrace)
Servicio sin `/ESBService/` (ej `ConsultaBolsillos`). Canal: `37`, varios `37,01`, `*` = todos. Rquid para la sección 4.

Pendiente: **1. API Gateway** (logs `/aws/api/*` no ingestados).

2.title: Respuestas adaptador
2.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| summarize responses = count()

3.title: % OK (2xx)
3.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(outcome == "ok_2xx") / count(), decimals: 2)

4.title: % 412 (negocio)
4.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(outcome == "business_412") / count(), decimals: 2)

5.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(outcome == "error") / count(), decimals: 2)

6.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR EN EL TIEMPO
6.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| filter isNotNull(code)
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| makeTimeseries responses = count(), by: { code }

7.title: SUMATORIA EVENTOS APIS
7.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| filter not (code >= 200 and code < 300)
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| parse content, "LD '\"code\":\"' LD:error_code '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"system\":\"' LD:error_system '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"message\":\"' LD:error_message '\"'"
| summarize total = count(), by: { code, error_system, error_code, error_message, service, channel }
| sort total desc
| limit 1000

8.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO (% sobre respuestas)
8.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::") or (contains(content, "GenericExceptionMapper") and contains(content, "HttpCode::"))
| fieldsAdd is_resp = contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' SPACE? INT:mapper_code"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize responses = countIf(is_resp), mapping_errors = countIf(not is_resp and mapper_code != 504), by: { service, channel }
| fieldsAdd pct_mapping = round(100.0 * mapping_errors / responses, decimals: 2)
| filter mapping_errors > 0
| sort mapping_errors desc
| limit 1000

9.title: TIMEOUTS ADAPTADOR 504 (% sobre respuestas)
9.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::") or (contains(content, "GenericExceptionMapper") and contains(content, "HttpCode::"))
| fieldsAdd is_resp = contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' SPACE? INT:mapper_code"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize responses = countIf(is_resp), timeouts = countIf(not is_resp and mapper_code == 504), by: { service, channel }
| fieldsAdd pct_timeout = round(100.0 * timeouts / responses, decimals: 2)
| filter timeouts > 0
| sort timeouts desc
| limit 1000

10.title: DETALLE ERRORES DE MAPEO
10.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "GenericExceptionMapper") and contains(content, "HttpCode::")
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' SPACE? INT:code"
| filter code != 504
| parse content, "LD 'Exception:' LD '::' SPACE? LD:message ' .'"
| parse content, "LD '3=' LD:field SPACE? '::HEAD::'"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| summarize total = count(), by: { code, message, field, service, channel }
| sort total desc
| limit 1000

11.title: RQUIDS CON ERROR 4XX/5XX
11.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "::AUDIT::RESP::")
| parse content, "LD '::HTTPCODE::' INT:code"
| fieldsAdd outcome = if(code >= 200 and code < 300, "ok_2xx", else: if(code == 412, "business_412", else: "error"))
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| filter outcome == "error"
| parse content, "LD 'X-RqUid=' LD:rquid ','"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Referer=' LD:referer ','"
| fieldsAdd service = splitString(referer, "-")[3]
| parse content, "LD '\"code\":\"' LD:error_code '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"system\":\"' LD:error_system '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"message\":\"' LD:error_message '\"'"
| fields timestamp, rquid, service, channel, code, error_system, error_message
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 200

13.title: % rechazo al canal (M)
13.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "<caracterAceptacion>") or contains(content, "<canal>")
| parse content, "LD '] [' LD:rquid '][INFO'"
| parse content, "LD '<Request>' LD '<canal>' LD:channel_req '</canal>'"
| parse content, "LD '<Response>' LD '<nombreOperacion>' LD:operation '</nombreOperacion>'"
| parse content, "LD '<caracterAceptacion>' LD:acceptance '</caracterAceptacion>'"
| parse content, "LD '<codMsgRespuesta>' LD:msg_code '</codMsgRespuesta>'"
| parse content, "LD '<msgRespuesta>' LD:msg '</msgRespuesta>'"
| summarize channel = takeAny(channel_req), operation = takeAny(operation), result = takeAny(acceptance),
    msg_code = takeAny(msg_code), msg = takeAny(msg), by: { rquid }
| filter isNotNull(result) and ($Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ",")))
| summarize value = round(100.0 * countIf(result == "M") / count(), decimals: 2)

14.title: LATENCIA POR PASO ESB
14.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "[/")
| fieldsAdd parts = arrayReverse(splitString(trim(content), "["))
| fieldsAdd step = replaceString(parts[1], "]", ""), step_time = replaceString(parts[0], "]", "")
| parse step_time, "DOUBLE:step_ms"
| filter isNotNull(step_ms) and step != "AuditLog"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel_a ','"
| parse content, "LD '][' LD:channel_b ']'"
| fieldsAdd channel = coalesce(channel_a, channel_b, "")
| filter $Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ","))
| summarize executions = count(), avg_ms = avg(step_ms), p95_ms = percentile(step_ms, 95), by: { step }
| sort p95_ms desc
| limit 100

15.title: RECHAZOS AL CANAL
15.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr")
| filter contains(content, $Servicio)
| filter contains(content, "<caracterAceptacion>") or contains(content, "<canal>")
| parse content, "LD '] [' LD:rquid '][INFO'"
| parse content, "LD '<Request>' LD '<canal>' LD:channel_req '</canal>'"
| parse content, "LD '<Response>' LD '<nombreOperacion>' LD:operation '</nombreOperacion>'"
| parse content, "LD '<caracterAceptacion>' LD:acceptance '</caracterAceptacion>'"
| parse content, "LD '<codMsgRespuesta>' LD:msg_code '</codMsgRespuesta>'"
| parse content, "LD '<msgRespuesta>' LD:msg '</msgRespuesta>'"
| summarize channel = takeAny(channel_req), operation = takeAny(operation), result = takeAny(acceptance),
    msg_code = takeAny(msg_code), msg = takeAny(msg), by: { rquid }
| filter isNotNull(result) and ($Canal == "*" or in(channel, splitString($Canal, ",")))
| filter result == "M"
| summarize rejections = count(), by: { channel, operation, msg_code, msg }
| sort rejections desc
| limit 100

17.title: TRAZA RQUID
17.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and (endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter") or endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr"))
| filter contains(content, $Rquid)
| fieldsAdd group = replaceString(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/", "")
| fields timestamp, group, content
| sort timestamp asc
| limit 1000

18.title: AUDITORIAS ADAPTADOR
18.query:
fetch logs
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, concat("/aws/ecs/srv/", $Cluster, "-")) and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-adapter")
| filter contains(content, $Rquid) and contains(content, "AUDIT")
| parse content, "LD 'X-FnctName=' LD:fnct_name ','"
| parse content, "LD 'X-Name=' LD:channel ','"
| parse content, "LD '::AUDIT::' LD:operation_type '::'"
| parse content, "LD '::AUDIT::' DATA:audit_message"
| fieldsAdd adapter = replaceString(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/", "")
| fields timestamp, fnct_name, channel, operation_type, adapter, audit_message
| sort timestamp asc
| limit 1000
